Subject: Re: Draft metered SKU table + product copy for AWS listing — review please

Emily — thanks, this is a useful starting point. Quick summary of our check below, and inline comments in the attached copy.

1) Metering dimensions
- Our runtime prefers per-invocation token-based metering (tokens consumed per call). The table mixes invocation-based and minute-based columns; that will confuse AWS usage report ingestion. Recommend we standardize on `tokens` and `invocations` as separate SKU dimensions.
- The suggested `metered-rt-100k` looks fine as a tier name but we prefer `metered-token-100k` to be explicit.

2) Entitlement mapping
- PrivateOffer should map to `enterprise` plan only. The `pro` plan can live as a public SKU with trial entitlements.
- Please add a column for `allowed-ami-regions` in the entitlement sheet; AWS needs explicit AMI region tags for GovCloud/Commercial separation. I flagged missing regions in `ami-mapping.csv`.

3) Product page copy
- Overall tone is good; tighten the usage example that references latency (we avoid promises like "sub-50ms" unless backed by a verified benchmark).
- Please add a short sentence about model variants and fallback (e.g., "Automatically falls back to a cost-optimized variant under capacity pressure"). That helps field questions.

Next steps: Kimberly — can you weigh in on the footnote language for billing and the SKU naming? Marissa — I'll queue a short doc we can share with AWS seller support to prevent back-and-forth on the metering format.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships — Marketplace & GTM, Redwood Inference

Subject: Metered SKU submission guidance / naming rules

Hi team,

Quick heads-up on naming and metering:
- SKU names should be alphanumeric with hyphens, max 40 chars. `metered-token-100k` is acceptable.
- For metering, AWS prefers a primary metric (e.g., `invocations`) and supports custom metrics (e.g., `tokens`) if provided via SellerPortal manifest. You will need to supply the CSV mapping for how `tokens` map to `unit_price` in USD per 1,000 tokens.
- AMI region tags are required for private offers. Please provide explicit region list (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1).

If you want, we can provision a sandbox listing so you can test the metering ingestion before going live. Reply with the sandbox request ID and a contact.

Thanks,
AWS Marketplace Seller Support
aws-seller-support@amazon.com

-----End forwarded message-----
